url_citation.title: Understanding Customer Reviews and Ratings - Amazon Customer Service
url_citation.content:
Guidelines for customer reviews and ratings.

How We Keep Reviews Trustworthy and Useful

To ensure only genuine customers post reviews, we have submission requirements.
Only customers who have spent at least $50 on Amazon in the last 12 months can submit ratings and reviews.
Before posting a review, we check if it meets our Community Guidelines . That includes our rules against creating, editing, and removing reviews in exchange for compensation.
We check if the reviewer bought or used (for example, streamed) the item on Amazon and paid a price available to most Amazon shoppers. If we confirm both, we label the review with Verified Purchase . Reviews without this label can also be helpful. For example, a customer buys an item from a different company, but wants to share their opinion on Amazon.

How we calculate overall star ratings

Amazon calculates a product's star rating using machine-learned models instead of a simple average.
These models consider factors such as how recent the rating or review is, and verified purchase status. They use multiple criteria that establish the authenticity of the feedback. The system continues to learn and improve over time.
We don’t consider customer ratings without an Amazon-Verified Purchase status in a product's overall star rating until a customer adds more

url_citation.content:
After you order from a third-party , you can share your experience by leaving comments, feedback, and ratings. You have 90 days from the date of your order to do this .
Only customers who have purchased a product from a seller through Amazon can leave comments, feedback and ratings about the seller.
By using any of these features, you agree to follow these guidelines, which we update from time to time.
Your comments, feedback, and ratings should focus on your buying experience and answer some of the following questions:
* Were you happy with how the seller packaged and shipped your order (for products) ?
* Did you receive your order on time and did you receive what you ordered?
* Was the seller professional and was their work of good quality?
* If applicable, did you get good customer service and did the seller fix your issue quickly?
* Would you buy from this seller again?
* What would have improved your experience?

Ratings

You can rate third-party sellers from one to five stars, with five stars being the best. The seller's average rating will appear beside their name on our site .

Comments and Feedback

To learn how to leave feedback for a seller, go to Leave Third-Party Seller Feedback .
